name: Indra Putra Mahayuda
tagline: AI Engineer specializing in Computer Vision, Deep RL & Production ML Systems
about: AI Engineer with 3+ years of hands-on experience delivering end-to-end machine learning systems across computer vision, deep reinforcement learning, and time series forecasting. Experienced in bridging research and production, from prototyping in notebooks to deploying scalable solutions on edge devices and cloud platforms. Contributed to radar-camera fusion for autonomous vehicles (published at IEEE IES 2024), achieved 1st place in Indonesia's National Humanoid Robot Competition, and currently optimizing large-scale mining fleet operations using deep reinforcement learning.

projects.title: Mining Fleet Optimization with Deep RL
projects.description: Developing deep reinforcement learning algorithms for dynamic dispatching and task optimization in mining operations. Includes time series forecasting for predictive maintenance and fuel consumption, processing large-scale telemetry data with measurable fleet efficiency improvements.

projects.title: Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS)
projects.description: Built a radar-camera fusion system for real-time human detection and distance measurement in vehicle ADAS. Achieved reliable object detection on embedded Jetson hardware. Published at IEEE International Electronics Symposium 2024.

projects.title: Humanoid Robot Vision System
projects.description: Developed the computer vision pipeline for humanoid robots competing in Indonesia's National Robot Soccer Competition (KRI). Built ball detection for interception/kicking and landmark-based localization for field positioning. Won 1st place (2021) and 3rd place (2022).

projects.title: Vectalent: AI-Powered CV Screening
projects.description: Built an end-to-end AI product that automates resume screening using LLMs, matching candidates to job requirements with intelligent scoring. Full-stack implementation with payment integration and user dashboard.

projects.title: SkyStrike MVC: Reinforcement Learning Arcade Agent
projects.description: Built a classic arcade shooter in C# with raylib-cs and embedded tabular Q-learning. The project supports manual play, in-game RL training, persisted Q-tables, CSV metric export, and inference mode using a learned policy.

projects.title: Sentiment Analysis: Japan vs Indonesia
projects.description: Analyzed Indonesian netizen reactions on Instagram after the national football team's 6-0 loss to Japan. Built a BERT-based sentiment classification pipeline to categorize thousands of comments into positive, negative, and neutral sentiments, revealing that supportive messages ("semangat") dominated despite the heavy defeat.

projects.title: IoT Monitoring Dashboard: Manufacturing
projects.description: Built a comprehensive real-time IoT monitoring system for PT TKHS manufacturing facility, providing live data visualization, device management, and alerting.

projects.title: IoT Monitoring Dashboard: Hospital
projects.description: Developed a real-time environmental monitoring solution for hospital critical areas, integrating sensors via MQTT and Node-RED for automated alerts and compliance tracking.
